scheduleName.description: Name of the schedule which determines when the simultaneous ring is in effect.

anonymousCallersEnabled.description: When `true`, the criteria applies to calls from anonymous callers.

unavailableCallersEnabled.description: When `true`, the criteria applies to calls from unavailable callers.

phoneNumbers.description: The list of phone numbers that will checked against incoming calls for a match.

ringEnabled.description: When set to `true` simultaneous ringing is enabled for calls that meet this criteria. Criteria with `ringEnabled` set to `false` take priority.

CallsFromType.description:
* `ANY_PHONE_NUMBER` - The Schedule applies to any phone number.
 * `SELECT_PHONE_NUMBERS` - Indicates the schedule applies to select phone number defined in the `phoneNumbers` property.

ScheduleLevel.description:
* `PEOPLE` - The schedule level that specifies that criteria is of People level.
 * `GROUP` - The schedule level that specifies that criteria is of Group level.

ScheduleType.description:
* `businessHours` - The schedule type that specifies the business or working hours during the day.
 * `holidays` - The schedule type that specifies the day when your organization is not open.
